title: テイルズ オブ デスティニー

layouts.notes: A stretch of script (several pages, 0C between them) sits in one buffer, and the game walks it with a pointer that is 0 once the stretch's last page is typed out. A page's first row is the speaker's name. The state at 0x801BEA3A: 0 no window, 1 opening, 2 closing, 3 typing or the last page complete, 4 waiting with more pages to come, 6 moving to the next page; so `waiting` isn't set on a stretch's last page. The pointer runs about one character ahead of what is drawn. Found by replaying the opening headless (docs/replay.md) over two maps; battles, shops, menus and choices not reached.

sources: Genkan memory search during play (about 19k characters of script resident in RAM)
Headless replay of the opening: 69 samples over 20 pages on two maps
